name: experience-ablation-s1-tooling
title: Experience-ablation S1: protocol freeze, pair ledger, and sample-size calculator (M0+M2+M5)
description: First build story of the experience-layer A/B ablation causal-validation program, implementing the three experiment-side tooling milestones of the rev-2 execution plan (docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md, merged via B-36fd): M0 protocol freeze (machine-validated protocol.json with sha256 protocol hash, per-population sample-size config, trap-group membership, and frozen memory-snapshot hash), M2 pair ledger (immutable fixture manifest + pair ledger + committed run-order seed with deterministic seeded shuffle), and M5 sample-size calculator (per-population adequacy report: unpaired two-proportion reference N, McNemar discordant-pair sizing, and the Wilson-CI pilot freeze rule helpers). All code lives under the new experiments/experience-ablation/ directory following the committed recovery-runner conventions (plain .mjs tools + hermetic *-selfcheck.mjs); no product code (packages/*) is touched. M1/M3/M4/M6-M9 are explicitly out of scope for this story.
